requestLede: Enter your account's email address and we will send you a six-digit code.
verifyLede: If an account uses {email}, we have sent a six-digit code to it.
codeHint: The code expires {minutes} minutes after it was sent and stops working after {attempts} wrong attempts.
verifyFailed: That code could not be used.
resent: If that address has an account, a new code is on its way. Earlier codes no longer work.
resendWait: You can request a new code in {time}.
resetLede: Changing it signs your account out on every device.
done: Your password has been changed and every device that was signed in has been signed out. Sign in with your new password.
